scope: P18-03 — four moving rubber wheels only; no source changes or native reexport
native_source_provenance: Real Blender4.0.2 FBX from existing successful run https://github.com/C8LyNn/Model-Test/actions/runs/41344872313; unchanged hashes; no redundant export
method: ACTUAL mesh vertices extracted from producer OBJ. For each rubber wheel (26 indexed mesh vertices; 48 triangles), compute AABB of wheel rotated about actual X axle through its real bbox center by 0..355 degrees every 5 degrees (72 positions), then compare x/y/z interval overlap with every 12 relevant fixed structural parts (decks, four frame uprights, corresponding wheel fork inner/outer/crown, anchor, gusset and anchor retainer). Full AABB disjoint => exact triangles cannot intersect at sampled pose. Continuous 360 spin additionally bounded by maximum radial source vertex distance (<=0.105m): wheel Y never exceeds axleY+0.105m=0.210m, near upright bottom Y=0.212m; fork disjoint X gap >=9mm and crown Y gap >=6mm.
verified_axes: X-parallel axle, source Y up; 4 independent wheel pivots and 8 wheel hub child objects preserved in existing FBX

findings.rubber_to_rigid_external_12_targets: 4×12 target structural AABB disjoint per 72 poses; 0 broadphase overlap cases
findings.movement_scope_caveats: Rubber-wheel spin only; does not simulate caster swivel, whole-cart travel over terrain, flex, wheel-hub-to-axle/fastener contact, two-sided material rendering or Unity physics. Hub-to-axle contacts intentionally expected; require independent review rather than false 'zero intersections'.
findings.minimum_clearance_is_design_slim: 2mm gap close to upright; review deformation/contact margin in actual Unity and manufacturing-style tolerance.

disposition.producer_mesh_repair: NO_CHANGE: no demonstrated geometry collision requiring repair
disposition.new_blend_export: NOT_RUN: unchanged asset; existing exact native is valid
